name: promiseproof
description: Deterministic product-promise verification for activity-based personalization.

scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development DEMO_MODE=initialization-race tsx watch src/server/main.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:health && npm run test:detector
